terminologyProfile.descriptionRule: Every visual claim is tied to a measurable component, material response, or evidence region.

referenceCamera.note: Single-view camera estimate for a centered orthographic-like hero prop; final runtime view is a separate gameplay camera.

objectClass.notes: The reference is an isolated gate prop with a clear central negative space, bilateral pillars, layered roof silhouette, repeated roof tiles, and high-frequency carved/metal accents.

reasoning: The roof is a nested three-dimensional silhouette rather than a flat sign.
Pillars, steps, brackets, ornaments, and lantern frames are separately readable and need stable pivots.
Roof tiles and relief medallions are repeated structures that must be instanced for runtime performance.

specDepthDecision.rationale: A single root primitive would lose the gate's negative space, roof hierarchy, repeated tiles, and local ornaments.

detailInventory.scanMethod: direct visual inspection plus imagegen reference crop review

details.description: Wet glazed roof tiles break the moon rim in five repeated courses.
Both roof edges turn upward at the outer corners with a bronze ridge.
Curled ridge tails terminate in jade finials.
Four raised vertical flutes add a narrow highlight rhythm to each pillar.
Three stacked circular jade emblems sit in the front relief strip of each pillar.
Layered capital blocks widen the top of each column beneath the beam.
Angled bracket members bridge the columns into the primary beam.
A circular bronze and jade crest anchors the center of the beam.
Two side pendants and one center pendant hang below the beam with visible gaps.
Five centered stone steps rise into the gate opening.
Four framed lanterns use repeated bronze bars around a warm core.
details.affects: light source and readable prop scale

details.description: Small jade caps terminate the stair rails and echo the beam crest.

definitionOfDone: The live model preserves the reference's tall bilateral gate silhouette, central negative space, tiered upturned roof, stepped approach, and jade/bronze accent hierarchy.
The model is composed of named runtime components with instanced repeated details and a documented LOD budget.
A real browser render proves the gate is visible in the gameplay scene without console errors or a frame-time regression.

visualDeltaChecks: roof tier and tile distribution delta
antiShallowSpecRules: Do not replace the gate with a background plate.
Do not replace raised relief or roof tiles with albedo alone.
Repeated roof details must be instanced or explicitly budgeted.
Do not claim visual pass without a browser render screenshot.
mustNotDo: Do not use a single box or cone as the finished gate.
Do not reuse albedo as roughness, height, normal, or AO.
Do not hide a broken factory model and call it approved without documenting the visible presentation model.

geometryDescriptor.normalStrategy: smoothed hard-surface normals with weighted relief normals

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: stacked beveled masonry and relief solids
geometryDescriptor.normalStrategy: weighted normals plus independent relief normals

componentTree.name: Right carved pillar

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: stacked beveled masonry and relief solids

componentTree.name: Carved crossbeam and brackets

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: layered beveled beams with angled structural braces
geometryDescriptor.normalStrategy: weighted beam normals and relief normals

componentTree.name: Two-tier upturned tiled roof

componentTree.name: Ceremonial stair approach
componentTree.topologyRationale: Five overlapping stair slabs, rails, posts, and jade caps create the raised approach without filling the gate opening.

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: stepped overlapping slabs with beveled contact edges

componentTree.name: Four framed warm lanterns

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: instanced frame members around emissive cores

componentTree.name: Central jade sun crest

componentTree.name: Instanced roof tile courses

componentTree.name: Curved upturned eaves

geometryDescriptor.topologyIntent: curved solid sweep with rounded section

componentTree.name: Column flute relief
componentTree.topologyRationale: Raised narrow cylinders form vertical relief strips over the column body and remain separate depth-bearing geometry.

componentTree.name: Five overlapping stair slabs

componentTree.name: Stacked bronze and jade medallions
componentTree.topologyRationale: Circular torus reliefs and faceted cores sit proud of the pillar panels and create real occlusion.

componentTree.name: Lower roof tier
componentTree.topologyRationale: A separate sloped roof mass carries the lower eave and tile course.

componentTree.name: Upper roof tier
componentTree.topologyRationale: A smaller second sloped roof mass creates the stepped silhouette and ridge hierarchy.

componentTree.name: Left capital stack
componentTree.topologyRationale: Layered cap blocks widen the left pillar at the beam joint.

componentTree.name: Right capital stack
componentTree.topologyRationale: Layered cap blocks widen the right pillar at the beam joint.

componentTree.name: Angled beam bracket set
componentTree.topologyRationale: Angled braces occupy the joint between the horizontal beam and pillars.

componentTree.name: Repeated lantern frame set
